## Design

### 2026-10-09 – Today I worked on downloading and setting up my 'workspace', downloading the necessary files and applications as indicated by Half Life and the Starbie Github docs.

**2h**

Today I worked on downloading and setting up my 'workspace', downloading the necessary files and applications as indicated by Half Life and the Starbie Github docs.
This involved setting up my venv `hack_club_venv`, implementing Hackatime for VScodium, creating a  new Github repo, adding the .zip care package to my repo, downloading  Lookout for Lapse, and downloading KiCad. I recorded my notes and findings into my `readme.md` in the `week1-starbie/` folder of my repo.
